note: python tools/research/phase7_extension/native_validation.py --binary target/release/axisforge         --models research/phase7_extension/native/learned_order_phase7.json         --dev research/phase6/dev_parts.json --library research/phase5/library_parts.txt --dev-catalogues cat80/         --dev-store store.json --dev-projects POOL --egad-pool EGAD_POOL --egad-conf CONF         --out research/phase7_extension/results/native_inference_validation.json --jobs 1  Tolerances fixed before running (stated in the output): features within 1e-12 absolute, probabilities within 1e-9 absolute, and identical decisions (first viable grasp and number of examined candidates) for every object and mode. Level 1 (research-candidates --learned): features and probabilities of every candidate of every development part (316) and EGAD object (345) against bl.features and predict_proba. Level 2 (plan --learned --order MODE --nr-grasps 1): the first grasp and the number of examined candidates of every viable object and mode against the Python order simulator; for EGAD the reference is the confirmation's own orders.json (frozen models), for development the same frozen models applied in Python here. The frozen P(F) was trained on all development parts, so development probabilities are in-sample: this checks equivalence, not accuracy.
